definitions.gloss: received email; incoming mail; inbox message
definitions.explanation: An email that has been received, as opposed to sent mail. Also refers to the inbox or received mail folder in an email application or on a mobile phone.

examples.japanese: {受信|じゅしん}メール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
{受信|じゅしん}メール⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{100件|ひゃっけん}たまって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have 100 unread emails piled up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な{受信|じゅしん}メール⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦フォルダ→フォルダ：05394_foruda⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っていない→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check whether any important received emails have ended up in the spam folder.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧ (reception, receiving) and ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧ (email, mail). On Japanese mobile phones, the mail app historically had distinct ⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧⟦ボックス→ボックス：30522_bokkusu⟧ (inbox) and ⟦{送信|そうしん}→送信：17692_soushin⟧⟦ボックス→ボックス：30522_bokkusu⟧ (sent box) labels. The term remains common even with modern email apps.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受信|じゅしん}メール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a received email
- {受信|じゅしん}メール⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of received emails
- {受信|じゅしん}メール⟦フォルダ→フォルダ：05394_foruda⟧: inbox folder
- {受信|じゅしん}メール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削除|さくじょ}→削除：04171_sakujo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to delete received emails

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{送信|そうしん}→送信：17692_soushin⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧: sent email — email that has been sent out
- ⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧⟦ボックス→ボックス：30522_bokkusu⟧: inbox — the folder/container for received messages
- ⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧: spam email — unwanted messages filtered out by the email system
